model: Freeze A27 J/A/G archive inference, local archive mass1/2 and external28-archive mass1/2; risk structural/full atoms each1/2 within archive. Full target contexts of the other three regimes must reproduce the same shared source parameters; stop on disagreement instead of mixing archive variants.
controls_models: J/A/G as frozen in A27. I: original learned local eta ARD/full mixture evaluated on each old path, regardless of that path's historical policy. analysis: Report all ten strata and nominal bootstrap intervals based on eight original seed-pair blocks, averaging both target seeds within pair. No pooling with A27 or previous versions. controls: Complete cohort identities,24-query histories and repeated visit chronology must match A21. Risk-only-shift regression stops deployment of J and requires a separately designed head-decoupling uncertainty model; do not tune mixture weights or choose a target-performing secondary model. No new search/KG/verifier campaign.

information_cost: Joint J, eta-only A and full-risk G each reuse the same28 external source archives172032 paid calls plus local archive6144. Original I/F uses one local archive. Existing source and target calls are reported as information use, with no new simulator calls.
limitations: Retrospective target development on old model-dependent query paths. Source-training sets overlap across pair folds. More source information and a joint conditional-head assumption are explicit. Predictive improvements do not prove better candidate choice, KG, independent verification, cost amortization or Operations Research readiness.
